purpose: Itemized cost rows that are BOTH rendered as a visible table and emitted as schema.org PriceSpecification. One dataset drives both surfaces, so the structured data can never claim a figure the page does not show.
policy: Every row states a RANGE and names where the figure came from. No figure is authored here: each is either already published on the route, or supplied by a landed citation run whose artifact is in data/report_fixes/agent_runs/. A route with no citable figure gets no PriceSpecification - an invented price is worse than an absent one, and worse still on a medical page.

/dentistry/dental-implants/.name: Dental implant cost in the United States
/dentistry/dental-implants/.intro: Published US market ranges. Implant pricing varies with technique, materials, grafting needs and the restoration, so treat these as a comparison band and ask each office for a written, itemized quote.
/dentistry/dental-implants/.disclaimer_scope: Cost ranges only. This page does not price your case and does not replace a written treatment plan and estimate from a licensed dentist.

/dentistry/clear-aligners/.name: Clear aligner cost in the United States, 2026
/dentistry/clear-aligners/.intro: Ranges by delivery model rather than by brand, because the delivery model is what actually moves the price. Refinements and retainers are frequently quoted separately.
/dentistry/clear-aligners/.disclaimer_scope: Cost ranges only. Whether aligners are clinically appropriate for your case is a decision for a licensed dentist or orthodontist, not a price comparison.

rows.note: Reported average around $2,000-$2,500. No in-person supervision is included.
Commonly excluded from the headline quote; ask whether refinements and the first retainer set are included.
